messages:
Asha: Quick heads-up — our token-cost attribution smoke diff is failing on staging. Seeing ~12% cost delta vs baseline. Need to triage owners + blocking PRs. @Ben @Carmen any insight?
Ben: saw this. Likely double-count from recent edge-router change. I have a local repro but need the latest event schema to confirm. pinging @Tamir for schema diff.
Carmen: adding context — the new attribute 'billing_units' was added in event.v2 last week, but downstream transformer expects 'tokens' — mismatch may cause duplication. PR #4721 touches both.
Tamir: I can share the schema diff. short snippet:
```json
{"name":"billing_units","type":"int","source":"ingest"}
```
Ben: thanks. If transformer doesn't dedupe on both fields we'll count both. Minimal patch: prioritize 'billing_units' as canonical and drop tokens at transform. I'll open PR.
Asha: ok. Owner model: @Ben to open PR + smoke tests; @Carmen to verify on staging; @Tamir to update schema registry + compat note. Timeline?
Carmen: I can validate tonight; if green, we can roll tomorrow morning. Leaving note: run `make smoke-attrib` and watch for 0.5% delta.
deploy-bot: CI / smoke pipeline kicked by Ben — job 8812 started. :rocket:
Ben: PR opened -> https://git.redwood/pr/4763 (WIP). Added dedupe, added unit test. Needs review from @Carmen.
Carmen: reviewing now. small nit on test names but LGTM after fix. :thumbsup:
Asha: thanks. Also quick ask — add a short entry in docs/telemetry.md about canonical billing field and dev checklist for instrumenting new events.
Tamir: will push schema note and bump registry version. leaving migration window: 48h.
Carmen: smoke passed in staging. delta down to 0.3%. Recommend canary 10% tomorrow 9:30am PT.
Asha: sounds good. I'll schedule the canary and send a calendar invite. tagging #finance for visibility. :calendar:
